items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Buddy Ford, the detective got killed in the Broadway, you see.

ctx.x: Crozat is what it's called now, but that's, it used to be Franklin. So we got, we walked back, I met Tony Perini, but I didn't know him that day. Yeah. He used to come around and listen to him. And Tony Jackson played a marvelous piano, he could sing like a woman. And when I was at Omaha, he wrote Pretty Baby, when I was at Omaha I picked up a copy of music of Some Sweet Day, had to go to color shows. See up in New York, people that had to go to color shows, they couldn't go to white. Beautiful number. Some sweet…
That was a very sensational case in those days. Oh yeah, they closed everything down, I've heard.
